meta.name: knowledge-agent
meta.description: Build and query AI-powered knowledge bases from claude-mem observations. Use when users want to create focused "brains" from their observation history, ask questions about past work patterns, or compile expertise on specific topics.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从对话历史构建可查询的知识库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望从日常对话中自动提炼知识并随时查询
copy.tagline_en: Build queryable knowledge bases from conversation history
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to automatically extract knowledge from daily conversations and query it anytime

howto.what: 它会从你的历史观察记录中挑出某个主题（如某项目、某类改动），整理成一个可对话的知识库；之后你能像聊天一样向这个知识库提问，它会依据这些记录回答，并支持追问。
howto.when: 当你想把观察历史整理成特定主题的知识库、询问过去的工作模式，或总结某专题经验时。

say.text: 把 hooks-expertise 语料库加载进会话
say.note: prime_corpus 会创建一个载入知识的 AI 会话。

say.text: 在 hooks-expertise 中提问：hooks 生命周期各阶段何时触发?
say.note: query_corpus 会基于语料库回答，还能追问。

howto.what_en: It builds focused, conversational knowledge bases from claude-mem observation history. After installation, you can query these corpora in plain language and get answers based on the selected observations, with follow-up context maintained.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to organize observation history into a topic-specific knowledge base, ask about past work patterns, or compile expertise on a subject.

say_en.text: Build a knowledge base about hooks with build_corpus, project claude-mem
Prime the hooks-expertise corpus into the session
say_en.note: Creates an AI session loaded with that knowledge.

say_en.text: In hooks-expertise, ask: when does each lifecycle hook fire?
say_en.note: Queries the corpus; follow-ups keep context.
